criteria.description: POST /api/admin/campaigns returns a 5-char id and a URL ending /?ref=<id>; the modal and Campaign table label it by name, never the id
Duplicate (case-insensitive) or empty/over-long name fails loudly; nothing written
Signup via real /api/auth/verify-otp with the id in ref, only utm_campaign, or only utm_source gets origin=<id>; GET /api/admin/campaigns counts all three; frontend captures a utm-only URL
Unregistered ref=my-ad-manager-name still becomes the origin verbatim (passes on base and head: behaviour kept)
Campaign table row reads the name with the id muted; rename relabels without touching user rows
Signup succeeds with a loud log when the campaigns table is missing
Non-admin sessions get 403 on every campaigns endpoint
Exactly one of the Campaign table / Cohort grid / Builds grid is in the DOM; pill row shows which (Builds disabled until T14000)
Cohort row clears campaign selection and vice versa; active selection shows as a chip next to Clear all when its table is hidden
Mount fires exactly one dashboard request; switching to an unloaded dimension fires that request once
Fresh store (reload) starts on Campaigns dimension
A signup on a server with APP_BUILD=4812 writes signup_build=4812 and the commit sha; pre-existing rows stay NULL
GET /api/admin/analytics/builds returns one row per build plus an unrecorded row; summed signups equal the cohort total for the same filters
Clicking a build row filters the user table, funnel and platform breakdown to that build; Clear all removes it
Signup still succeeds when signup_build does not exist yet (migration not run), with a loud log line
Campaigns, Cohorts and Builds tables show the same KPI columns: Signups, Revenue, Upload Success %, Uploaded/Clipped/Exported/Shared/Purchased %

Pulse cards show only the remaining KPIs (Exports, Active Users, Viral Conv. as daily flow; Avg Exports, Time-to-Export, 7d Return as population values) for the active selection; upload-collapse alarm kept
Coverage is not restarted mid-run: plugin raises TEST_BATCH_SIZE and fails loudly if the attribute is gone
Import-time executed lines are recorded (function bodies excluded) and import/collection errors fail the run
always_run.json lists test files that spawn processes (pool submit, Popen, fork/spawn)
third-party ModuleNotFoundError recorded in unimportable, not fatal; other errors still fatal
unimportable-path change or old-shape import_lines.json plans the full suite
